email.subject: Quick fix for Honey Group's website
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I checked Honey Group Hair Studio's site and noticed it isn't mobile-friendly, and your phone number isn't clickable on mobile. Since most people search for a salon on their phone and tap to call right away, both issues likely mean lost bookings every week.

I also noticed the footer looks outdated and your hours aren't listed, which can make people unsure if you're open.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's costing you customers?

Alex
Northlight Web
